title: Pull latest changes before local repository YAML job work
summary: Before performing work on an existing local Git repository through a YAML-specified execution job, run git pull in that verified repository to retrieve the latest remote changes rather than operating on an assumed-current checkout.
statement: Before performing work on an existing local Git repository through a YAML-specified execution job, run git pull in that verified repository to retrieve the latest remote changes rather than operating on an assumed-current checkout.

conditions: Job targets an existing explicitly authorized local repository.
exceptions: Does not authorize changing unrelated or substitute repositories.
